description: Ethereum network-level metrics (Etherscan dailytx or CoinMetrics TxCnt fallback)
known_limitations: transaction counts are network-level; no exchange segmentation

Etherscan unavailable (no free API key in .env); used CoinMetrics TxCnt instead. Add ETHERSCAN_API_KEY (free tier) to D:\kp_ai_agent\Dataset_Fetcher\.env and re-run --phases phase1_eth to upgrade to full dailytx fields.
